title: Praxis artifact provenance
description: The accumulated contribution history carried in an artifact's front matter as `provenance` (RQ-ROS-2026-A004) and projected verbatim into generated registries. Contributions are keyed by the execution (EXE-...) that produced them, or by a generated contribution ID (CTB-...) for a non-agent contributor acting outside any execution. The history is append-only: entries are added or extended, never replaced. Unknown fields are preserved so stronger attestation can be added later.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC time of this execution's first recorded operation on the artifact.

last.description: ISO-8601 UTC time of this execution's latest recorded operation, when later than `at`.
